name: Gradle
description: Wrapper is TLS-only by default; SHA-256 pinning exists but is opt-in and absent from the generated wrapper; corrupt-zip retry fetches the hash from the same server.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: The inspected Gradle wrapper supports SHA-256 checking through distributionSha256Sum configuration. This supports a configurable integrity control, not a complete publisher-authentication classification for all generated wrappers.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot, not the historical Gradle wrapper revision under study.

The fallback .sha256 value is a checksum, not an independent publisher signature; release-side checksum publication and generated-wrapper defaults beyond this checkout were not independently verified.
